Name: Less Corrupt Lewis - No More Statue
Author: AirynS
Description:
A simple little mod that changes the Solid Gold Lewis statue to a plaster sculpture of Marnie and changes Lewis’s letter so that he doesn’t try to bribe you in order to keep it quiet. Untested on Android but it should be compatible.

To install, simply extract the "[CP] Less Corrupt Lewis - No More Statue" folder and drop it in your Mods folder.
